svg.aria-label: recallweave forgetting weave: threads fade as memories expire and are compacted away
svg.title: recallweave: the forgetting weave
svg.desc: An animated panel showing the forgetting lifecycle: live threads on the left stay solid, an expiring thread fades to dashed as its time-to-live elapses, a tombstoned thread is cut, and compaction re-weaves the remaining live threads into a tighter cloth.
